Perhaps the function expects fuelAmount <= available capacity left? It might interpret fuelAmount as total desired? Or maybe it expects fuelAmount <= remaining capacity but we gave 39 which is less than remaining capacity (~147). Should be fine. But error says cannot fill above capacity. Could be because we didn't specify unit? The function signature: fuelAmount: float. Might be expecting gallons? Wait earlier function gallon_to_liter exists. But fillFuelTank expects gallons? So we passed 39 liters but function expects gallons. So we need to convert 39 liters to gallons. 1 gallon = 3.78541 liters. 39 liters = 10.29 gallons. So we should call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount 10.29 gallons. But we need integer? They said minimal integer value of liters. But function expects gallons. We'll convert 39 liters to gallons: 39 / 3.78541 ≈ 10.298. Round up to integer gallons? They didn't say rounding for gallons. We'll pass 10.3 gallons. But function may accept float. Let's pass 10.3.
